evals.name: proposal creates one linked implementation slice
evals.prompt: Propose one implementation slice for feature ticket FEAT-42 and existing approved component requirement REQ-002. The rationale is to let reviewers create and reuse a named filter, the outcome is one bounded change, and sharing filters across organizations is out of scope. Add a decision only if a material specification choice requires one. Do not refine software requirements or create tasks.
evals.expected_output: Writes one proposed CHG linked by featureTicketId=FEAT-42 and addresses REQ-002. It creates no requirements, tracker changes, or task checklist unless a concrete specification decision is required.

expectations.text: The implementation slice uses the shared feature ticket ID.
The change traces to the existing approved component requirement.
Proposal does not create a temporary task checklist.
Proposal does not create external tracker tickets.
